correctness.rationale: Derived missing-species probabilities Q_i and Q_ij under hypergeometric versus multinomial occupancy; using Bernoulli presence indicators gives Var(K)=sum_i Q_i(1-Q_i)+2sum_{i<j}(Q_ij-Q_i Q_j). All positive abundance profiles with N<=6 are exactly the 29 integer partitions; independent exact rational enumeration verified each sample depth including N=6 unique (4,1,1), and the three stated fractions. For a_t=(2t,1 repeated t), the variance reduces to four missing-event types. Independently symbolically simplified the derived finite-minus-iid differences at m=2 and m=3 to the stated rational functions in t; the degree-seven m=3 numerator after t=u+2 has eight strictly positive coefficients. At m=N the without-replacement variance is zero and the iid richness is nondegenerate, hence negative. These exact all-t calculations and exhaustive N<=6 partition classification, not a finite extrapolation, establish the claim.
